purpose: Teach: 解い/こぼれ/海老/くれぐれも/元旦/眠気/病人/想い出

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、絵本のなぞなぞ、ちゃんと、自分で、解いたんだね、本当に、すごいよ、メイ姉さん、誇りに、思うわよ、翔くん。
lines.en: Sho — you solved that picture-riddle all by yourself, didn't you? That's really amazing. Mei-sis is so proud of you.
lines.style: Warm, steady voice with genuine delight. Soft emphasis on his accomplishment. Open, maternal tone without condescension. A beat of real admiration underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ジュース、こぼれちゃったの、ぼく、ティッシュ、取ってあげるね、待ってて、お願いね、すぐ、戻るからね。
lines.en: Mei-sis, the juice spilled. I'll get tissues for you, okay? Just wait — I'll be right back, I promise.
lines.style: Quick, purposeful movement in the voice. Bright, eager to help. Small-child certainty that this matters. A touch of protectiveness underneath the helpfulness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お祝いに、メイ姉さん、海老料理、たくさん、ご馳走してあげるね、翔くん、楽しみにしててね、本当に、絶対に、約束しようね。
lines.en: To celebrate, Mei-sis is going to treat you to lots of shrimp dishes, okay? You're going to love it. I'm really promising you that.
lines.style: Generous, slow delivery. Voice settles into the promise like it's something precious. Warm but careful — making sure he feels the certainty of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、くれぐれも、お疲れの時、無理、しないでね、ぼく、心配だから、お祖母ちゃんも、心配してたよ、メイ姉さん。
lines.en: Mei-sis, please don't push yourself too hard when you're tired, okay? I worry about you. Granny worries too.
lines.style: Soft but steady. Hesitant-careful, like he's checking whether it's okay to say this. Genuine concern underneath, spoken with small-child sincerity, not performing worry.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 元旦、メイ姉さん、翔くんに、お年玉、用意してあげるからね、ちゃんと、貯金してね、約束、しようね、翔くん、楽しみね。
lines.en: On New Year's Day, Mei-sis will have money for you — a gift, okay? You save it like I told you. I'm promising. That'll be fun.
lines.style: Light, playful warmth with an undertone of ritual certainty. The voice of someone making traditions. Each promise landing separately, carefully.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 眠気、ぼく、まだ、ないよ、メイ姉さん、お話、もっと、しようよ、ぼく、メイ姉さんと、いる時間、大好きなんだ、本当に。
lines.en: I'm not even sleepy yet, Mei-sis. Can we keep talking? I really love being with you like this. Really.
lines.style: Soft, genuine plea without whining. Open, unguarded. The honesty of a child who doesn't yet know how to hide what matters. Small voice, big feeling.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 病人の方、お見舞いに、行く時、翔くんも、メイ姉さんと、一緒に、来てね、優しい子に、なって欲しいの、本当に、メイ姉さん、お願い。
lines.en: When we visit someone who's sick, will you take me with you? I want to be a kind person. Mei-sis is asking you to help me with that.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest request. Slight hesitation — he's being brave about asking. Voice carries both the child's desire to be like her and the weight of understanding what 'kind' means.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんとの想い出、ぼく、本当に、たくさん、あるんだよ、これからも、たくさん、作ろうね、ね、約束、絶対、本当に、嬉しいよ。
lines.en: I have so many memories with you, Mei-sis. Let's make lots more, okay? Promise me we will. I promise too. I'm really, really happy about that.
lines.style: Soft, deliberate sincerity. No rushing. Each phrase placed like a small gift. Building toward the quiet joy at the end. Real conviction in the promises.
